title: Akiyama Mizuki — To Be There With You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, everyone! It's time for another fun day of work♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Pipe down, Amia!
We can hear you perfectly fine without shouting!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm turning Amia and Enanan's volume down.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, Yuki, why are you turning me down too?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm not being that loud, am I?!
Argh! Amia, this is all your fault!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry!
I promise not to be any louder than normal.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Umm... I don't think there's anything wrong with being a little excited.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But there is a limit.
I mean, why are you so giddy today?
Did something good happen?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Not exactly. I just thought that it might be good to create a fun and cheerful atmosphere while we work today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Because Yuki's going home.
I figured that it'd be nice to sort of mark the occasion.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay?
Well, Yuki, how do you feel about this?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I don't think it's necessary...
Even at home, I should be able to work without any issues.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Wait, aren't you sad at all?
Also, K's sitting right next to you. You're going to make her feel so lonely she might start crying.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I'm not crying.
It's true I might feel a little lonely...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, you gave us those bracelets so she wouldn't feel lonely, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup! I made some for us the other day.
I thought we could all wear them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike Kanade, we can't be there when you talk to her, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I thought these would help make it feel like we're there with you in spirit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, I'm surprised that you got bracelets for all of us and not just Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. Seriously, where did you find the time?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hang on. Didn't you say that you made these yourself, Amia? They look really nice and well-made.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right! I took some DIY kits and threw in a few extra goodies♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, what do you mean goodies?
Was it hard to make these? Can you show me what you did?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But you don't like super detailed work, right, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For example, I had to take pieces of wire that were less than a centimeter long and turn them into perfect rings...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I also counted out the rings on each chain in order to make sure the decorations were evenly spaced and positioned right.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You counted them out? But these rings are so little, and there are just so many of them.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Exactly! You gotta be really careful when trying to evenly space out decorations.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What else was there...? When actually putting on the clasps and stuff, I had pliers in both hands. One I used like a vice, while I used the other to close off the little rings.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yikes. I guess it isn't as simple as just attaching decorations to the chain, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <There are simpler designs, if you're not married to the chain idea...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, they have those plastic wire types too. You just slide on the beads and decorations and then tie off the ends.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But then they wouldn't be the same as the ones you made, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I was hoping to make my own if it was easy enough.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm also surprised just how complicated these bracelets are. It sounds like it took a lot of work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A lot of accessories use really tiny bits and bobs, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I worked especially hard on those bracelets, so I hope you all use them!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It might only act as a brief distraction...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I hope it helps cheer Mafuyu up, even just a little.)
